content: Real-time dashboard architecture is layered: ingestion layer (events pushed via websocket/queue), a stateful processor that maintains derived/aggregated state, and a reactive frontend that patches only the affected UI elements rather than re-rendering everything. Recommended pattern: centralize websocket handling in one client-side manager, normalize incoming events into a typed store, and let UI components subscribe to slices of that store (matches company-state-engine -> pixel-office rendering split).
